code:
direction right
colorMode pastel
styleMode shadow
typeface clean

Producer [label: "Producer apps", icon: code, color: blue]

Relay [label: "Relay API (Go)", icon: server, color: black] {
  API [label: "POST /events", icon: server]
  Guard [label: "API key + idempotency", icon: shield]
  Outbox [label: "Outbox writer", icon: database]
}

PG [label: "Postgres: outbox + attempts", icon: postgres]
Queue [label: "SQS queue", icon: kafka, color: orange]

Workers [label: "Delivery workers", icon: cloud, color: green] {
  Worker [label: "HMAC signer", icon: shield]
  Retry [label: "Backoff + jitter", icon: refresh]
  DLQ [label: "Dead letter queue", icon: alert-triangle]
}

Endpoints [label: "Customer endpoints", icon: globe, color: green]
Ops [label: "Ops dashboard", icon: activity, color: grey]

Producer > Relay: events
Relay > PG: event + outbox, one transaction
PG > Queue: relay poll
Queue > Workers: delivery jobs
Workers > Endpoints: signed POST
Workers --> PG: attempt log
Ops --> PG: retries, status
